lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to warn Pharaoh of frogs if he refuses to let His people go.
Pharaoh asks Moses to pray for the frogs to go, and Moses agrees to do it on the third day.
Aaron cries out to the LORD, and the frogs die, but Pharaoh hardens his heart when he sees relief.
Aaron strikes the dust and it becomes gnats, the magicians cannot copy it, and they call it God's finger.
